title: セイバールート十一日目-118

pages.ja:
ひときわ高い木々の合間を抜けると、目の前には予想
外のモノが佇んでいた。
pages.jaRuby:
ひときわ高い木々の合間を抜けると、目の前には予想
外のモノが佇んでいた。
pages.en: We pass between a stand of unusually tall trees, and something completely unexpected appears before us.
pages.mirrorMoon: Once we pass between the exceptionally tall trees, an unexpected sight appears before me.

pages.ja:
「……廃、墟……？」
セイバーを抱きかかえたまま、呆然と建物を見上げて
しまう。
どのような由縁なのか、こんな樹海のただ中に建てら
れたソレは、今では人気の絶えた廃墟となっている。
pages.jaRuby:
「……廃、墟……？」

しまう。
どのような由縁なのか、こんな樹海のただ中に建てら
れたソレは、今では[ruby text=" ひ と"]人[ruby text=" け"]気の絶えた廃墟となっている。
pages.en:
“...A... ruin...?”

Still carrying Saber in my arms, I stare blankly up at the building.

Whatever its history may be, something built in the middle of this sea of trees has long since become an abandoned ruin with no sign of human life.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…A ruin…?”
Holding Saber, I look at the building with blank amazement.
I don’t know why, but this building in the woods is now a desolate ruin.

pages.ja:
「ここならしばらくは身を隠せるでしょ。
来る時にね、アーチャーが見つけておいたのよ。万が
一の時の隠れ場所にしようって」
どんな神経をしているのか、遠坂はざかざかと廃墟へ
と入っていく。

pages.en:
“We should be able to hide here for a while.
Archer found it on the way in. He said we could use it as a fallback hiding place if things went wrong.”

Apparently possessing nerves I cannot begin to understand, Tohsaka strides straight into the ruin.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“We should be able to hide here for a while.
Archer found this as a place to hide on our way here.”
I don’t know what kind of nerves she has, but Tohsaka enters the ruin.

pages.ja:
「……まあ、これ以上崩れる事はないか」
瓦礫を踏み越えて入り口に向かう。
……絶えてどれほどの年月が経っているのか。
建物は、緑に浸食された亡骸のようでもあった。
pages.jaRuby:
「……まあ、これ以上崩れる事はないか」
瓦礫を踏み越えて入り口に向かう。
……絶えてどれほどの年月が経っているのか。
建物は、緑に浸食された亡骸のようでもあった。
pages.en:
“...Well, I guess it can’t collapse much more than it already has.”

I step over the rubble toward the entrance.

...I have no idea how many years have passed since anyone lived here.

The building looks like a corpse being swallowed by greenery.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Well, I guess it won’t crumble any more than it already has.”
I head towards the entrance stepping over the rubble.
…How long has it been since it was abandoned?
The building seems like a corpse desecrated by the forest.

pages.ja:
廃墟の一階は、その全てが木々に浸食されていた。
部屋として使えるのは二階ぐらいで、その中でも一番
まともな部屋がここだった。
窓は奇跡的に残っている。
どういう仕組みなのか、ここからは高い夜空が覗けて
いた。
pages.jaRuby:

部屋として使えるのは二階ぐらいで、その中でも一番
まともな部屋がここだった。
窓は奇跡的に残っている。

いた。
pages.en:
—The entire first floor has been invaded by trees and vines.

Only the second floor has anything you could still call a room, and this is the most intact one we can find.

Miraculously, the window is still there.

Somehow, from here we can see a high stretch of night sky.
pages.mirrorMoon:
The entire ground floor is taken over by trees.
The only usable rooms are on the second floor, and this is the best of those.
Miraculously, the windows are still intact.
I don’t know how, but I can see the night sky from here.

pages.ja:
「ふーん。割合キレイじゃない。もしかしたら、最近ま
で誰かが寝泊まりしてたのかもね」
pages.jaRuby:
「ふーん。割合キレイじゃない。もしかしたら、最近ま
で誰かが寝泊まりしてたのかもね」
pages.en: “Huh. It’s cleaner than I expected. Maybe somebody was still sleeping here until fairly recently.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Hmm. It’s pretty clean in here. Maybe someone was staying here until recently.”

……ほんと、どういう神経しているのか。
遠坂は瓦礫をピシパシと踏みつけながら、壁際にある
ベッドをパンパンとはたいている。

pages.en:
...Seriously. What kind of nerves does she have?

Tohsaka crunches over the debris and briskly dusts off a bed sitting against the wall.
pages.mirrorMoon:
……Really, what kind of nerves does she have?
Stepping over the rubble, Tohsaka is dusting off the bed by the window.
“Shirou, this way. We have to lie Saber down. It’s pretty tiring being held by someone.”

人に抱かれているのって、けっこう体力使うのよ」
「あ
ああ、今行く」
ベッドまで注意深く歩いていって、静かにセイバーを
下ろした。

pages.en:
“Shirou, over here. We need to lay Saber down.
Being carried around by someone actually takes a fair amount of stamina.”

“Y-yeah. Coming.”

I walk carefully to the bed and lower Saber onto it as gently as I can.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Ohyeah, I’ll be right there.”
I lay Saber down on the old bed.

pages.ja:
「どう、苦しいセイバー？ まだ体を動かすぐらいは問
題ない？」
「……ええ、シロウがここまで運んでくれましたから。
まだ体を保っていられるようです」
pages.jaRuby:
「どう、苦しいセイバー？ まだ体を動かすぐらいは問
題ない？」
「……ええ、シロウがここまで運んでくれましたから。
まだ体を保っていられるようです」
pages.en:
“How is it, Saber? Are you in pain? Can you still move your body at all?”

“...Yes. Shirou carried me all the way here.
It seems I can still maintain my body for now.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“How are you feeling, Saber? Can you still move okay?”
“…Yes, since Shirou carried me here. It seems I can still sustain my body.”

そう。ならあとはこっちの問題だけか。
あれから一時間は経ってるものね。イリヤスフィール
が追ってくるにしても、もう少し時間はかかるでしょう。
……ううん、探すのに手間取れば朝方ぐらいまでは隠
れていられるかな」

pages.en:
“—Good. Then all that’s left is our other problem.
It’s been at least an hour. Even if Illyasviel comes after us, it should take her a little longer to get here.
...Actually, if she has trouble finding us, we might be able to stay hidden until around dawn.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I see. Then I guess there’s only one problem left.
It’s been an hour… We should have a bit more time even if Illyasviel comes after us immediately. No, we might be able to hide here until morning if they have trouble finding us.”

pages.en:
“Ah—”

That reminds me.

We escaped all the way to this ruin, but what happened to Berserker and Archer?

Archer stayed behind at the castle to hold Berserker off.

More than an hour has passed by now.

In that case, Archer should have withdrawn from the mansion on his own by this point—
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh”
Her mumbling reminds me.
We were able to make it to this ruin, but what happened to Berserker and Archer?
He remained at the castle to keep Berserker there.
It’s already been more than an hour.
So Archer should already have retreated as well
…It’s been over an hour. So Archer should already have retreated from the castle as well

“Tohsaka, what happened to—”

“......”

Tohsaka does not answer.

She only presses her right hand to her chest, as though holding something precious there.

...And with that, I understand Archer’s fate.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Tohsaka, what happened to him?”
“”
Tohsaka doesn’t answer.
She just places her right hand on her chest as if holding something dear.

pages.ja:
遠坂の令呪は右手にある。
マスターとサーヴァントは繋がっている。
セイバーが俺の危険を察したように、マスターもサー
ヴァントの生死が判るのだとしたら、それは。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Tohsaka’s Command Spells are on her right hand.

Master and Servant are connected.

If a Master can sense whether a Servant lives or dies, just as Saber could sense when I was in danger, then—
pages.mirrorMoon:
…That tells me of Archer’s fate.
Tohsaka’s Command Spell is on her right arm.
The Master and the Servant are connected.
As Saber sensed my danger, if the Master can sense the life and death of their Servant…

アイツ

pages.en:
“...Tohsaka. Archer...”

“Yeah. I told him all he had to do was buy us time.
That idiot—he had to stay smug right to the very end.”

She murmurs it as if laughing off an unpleasant rumor.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Tohsaka, he…”
“Yeah. And I told him he just needed to buy us some time.
Hewas arrogant to the very end.”
Tohsaka murmurs as if laughing off a bad rumor.

pages.ja:
……沈黙が落ちる。
永遠に続くかと思われたそれは、しかし。
「
けど無駄になんかしない。アーチャーを失った
以上、バーサーカーはここで倒す」
ぱん、と左手に右拳を打ち付ける音で破られた。
pages.jaRuby:

「
けど無駄になんかしない。アーチャーを失った
以上、バーサーカーはここで倒す」
ぱん、と左手に右拳を打ち付ける音で破られた。
pages.en:
...Silence falls.

It feels as though it might last forever.

Then—

“—But I’m not going to let it be for nothing. Now that Archer is gone, we’re killing Berserker here.”

The silence breaks with the sharp clap of her right fist striking her left palm.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…Silence follows.
The silence that seems to last forever is…
“But I won’t let it be meaningless. Since I’ve lost Archer, I’ll get Berserker here.”
…Aborted by the sound of Tohsaka punching her left hand with her right.

pages.ja:
「悔やむのはここまでよ。悩んでる暇があったら行動す
るのが私の信条。
ここまできたら、貴方たちにも
覚悟を決めてもらうからね」
「……？ 覚悟って、なんのだよ」
pages.jaRuby:
「悔やむのはここまでよ。悩んでる暇があったら行動す
るのが私の信条。
ここまできたら、貴方たちにも
覚悟を決めてもらうからね」
「……？ 覚悟って、なんのだよ」
pages.en:
“That’s enough regret. My rule is that if you have time to brood, you have time to act.
—Now that we’ve come this far, you two are going to have to make up your minds too.”

“...? Make up our minds about what?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Mourning is over. I believe in acting if I have time to worry. Since it’s come this far, I’m going to make sure you’re resolved as well.”
“…? Resolved? For what?”

pages.ja:
「決まってるじゃない。イリヤスフィール……バーサー
カーを倒す覚悟よ。
セイバーを連れてたらこの森からは出られないし、彼
女を回復させるにしたって時間がかかる。どのみちイリ
ヤに追い付かれるわ」
pages.jaRuby:
「決まってるじゃない。イリヤスフィール……バーサー

pages.en:
“What do you think? About killing Illyasviel—about killing Berserker.
We can’t get out of this forest while carrying Saber, and it’ll take time to restore her. Illya will catch up to us either way.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Resolved to beat Illyasviel… Berserker, of course.
We can’t escape this forest with Saber, and it’s going to take a long time even if we are to heal her. Illya will catch us either way.”

pages.ja:
「判る？ わたしたちが三人そろって森から出るには、
バーサーカーを倒すしかない。
それが出来なければ、わたしたちもアーチャーの後を
追うだけよ」
pages.jaRuby:
「判る？ わたしたちが三人そろって森から出るには、
バーサーカーを倒すしかない。
それが出来なければ、わたしたちもアーチャーの後を
追うだけよ」
pages.en:
“Do you understand? If all three of us are going to leave this forest alive, we have no choice but to defeat Berserker.
If we can’t, we’ll just be following Archer.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Do you get it? For us to escape the forest with all three of us, we have to defeat Berserker.
If we can’t, we’ll just share Archer’s fate.”

する、あの死の旋風を倒す……？

pages.en:
“—Defeat... Berserker...?”

That monster?

The storm of death that nullifies every attack and smashes anything it touches in a single blow... defeat that?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Beat Berserker…?”
That monster?
Beat that whirlwind of death that nullifies every attack and destroys all that it touches in a single blow…?

pages.en:

I cannot even imagine it.

If we fight him, we die.

Tohsaka has to understand that too.

After having that fact driven into us, she is still saying we should beat him?
pages.mirrorMoon:
“”
I can’t even imagine that.
Anything that fights him will die.
Tohsaka must know that as well.
Is she saying we’ll beat it in spite of that?

pages.ja:
「
いや、違う」

遠坂は倒せる、と言っているんじゃない。
そんな希望、初めからこいつは持っていない。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“——No. That’s not it.”

What am I thinking?

Tohsaka is not saying that we can defeat him.

She never had that kind of hope to begin with.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“No, that’s not right.”
What am I saying?
Tohsaka isn’t saying we can beat it.
She has no such false hopes.

……こんなコト、一番初めに気が付くべきだった。
「倒すしか、ないんだな」
これは、ただそれだけの話。
ここで死にたくないのなら。
俺たちは、あの怪物を倒すしかないだけなんだと。

pages.en:
“Ah—right. I get it.”

Yes. We are not defeating him because that is how we win.

...I should have realized this immediately.

“We just... don’t have any other choice.”

That is all there is to it.

—If we do not want to die here,

then we have no choice but to kill that monster.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“OhI see…”
That’s right. We’re not going to beat him to win.
…I should have realized that immediately.
“Our only option is to beat him.”
It’s just that.
If we don’t want to die here…
We have to beat that monster.

“Exactly. But it isn’t quite as hopeless as it sounds.
Even Berserker should have taken some kind of damage after fighting Archer. I brought every one of my best jewels, and if Saber can recover, we can probably come up with at least one or two ways out of this.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That’s right. But it’s not that hopeless.
Even if it’s Berserker, he should be wounded after fighting Archer. And I have all my reserve jewels, so if Saber recovers, I can come up with a few plans to beat him.”

pages.ja:
「
逆に言えばね。
バーサーカーが傷を負っている今こそ、イリヤスフィー
ルを倒せる最大の機会だと思わない？」
pages.jaRuby:
「
逆に言えばね。

pages.en:
“—Put another way,
if Berserker is injured right now, don’t you think this is our best chance to defeat Illyasviel?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Looking at it from the other side,
Since Berserker is wounded right now, don’t you think this is our best chance to beat Illyasviel?”

いけど、こんな場所でセイバーを治せるとは思えない」

pages.mirrorMoon:

But
